name: Seahorse Valley
text: A descent into the seahorse-tailed filaments threading the cleft between the main cardioid and the period-2 bulb — self-similar spirals all the way down to the center of an infinite whirlpool.

name: From Elephant Valley to Pod
text: Out along the elephant-trunk valley on the cardioid's right flank, marching through herds of trunks toward a hidden mini-Mandelbrot pod.

name: Always Connected
text: However thin the filaments grow, the set never breaks apart — a visual meditation on Douady & Hubbard's theorem that the Mandelbrot set is connected.

name: Infinite Spiral Arms
text: A descent into the triple-spiral country off the cardioid's upper cusp, where each arm unwinds into a smaller arm, and that one into another — staircases of whirlpools that keep turning long after the eye loses count.

name: Hidden Bulb at a Junction
text: Down the slender antenna west of the period-2 bulb to a crossroads of filaments — branches radiating outward like a starburst — where, folded into the very center of the junction, hides a tiny perfect copy of the whole Mandelbrot set.

name: From Multi-Line to Tri-attractors
text: Into the narrow neck where the main cardioid meets the period-2 bulb, where filaments crowd together by the thousand, until the tangle unwinds into three radiant foci — a trio of attracting centers the branches spiral around without end.
